description: Edits a campaign as its builder does (the fields you pass change; the rest stay), or pauses (status paused, pulls back its queued sends) or archives it. Turning automatic sending off (auto_send false) is open. To start or resume one, use start_campaign (your person confirms first). Held for the owner, refused with where: starting it here, turning automatic sending on, and changing the messages, audience, caps or send window of a started campaign that sends automatically (turn auto_send off first, in the same call or before). Templates, offer and audience_filter follow the same rules as create_campaign (listed on each field). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

audience_filter.description: Who the campaign is for, as the builder's Audience section sets it. Use these keys only; every key given must hold.

frequency.description: one_time: never had a recurring plan; recurring: has had one; any: no restriction.

maxDaysSinceLastVisit.description: At most this many days since their most recent booking (leave out for no upper limit).

maxLastTicketCents.description: Their most recent booking totalled at most this, in cents. "Original booking $300 or less" is 30000. A booking with no known total is left out.

maxVisits.description: At most this many past bookings. "One-time clients" (booked exactly once) is maxVisits 1 with minVisits 1; 0 means never booked (leads), and then the last-booking bounds do not apply.

minDaysSinceLastContact.description: Quiet for at least this many days: no text, call or email with them either way (since they were added, if there has been none). "Haven't heard from them since" a booking N days ago is N.

minDaysSinceLastVisit.description: At least this many days since their most recent booking. "Booked 90+ days ago" is 90.

minLastTicketCents.description: Their most recent booking totalled at least this, in cents ($150 is 15000).

minVisits.description: At least this many past bookings.

noUpcomingBooking.description: true leaves out anyone with a booking already on the calendar.

services.description: Their most recent booking was one of these services, named as the business names them on its bookings.

audience_source.description: Instead of audience_filter, follow Contacts: { kind: "list", listId } | { kind: "view", viewId } | { kind: "people", clientIds: [...] } | { kind: "filter", query: { scope?, match?, filters: [...] } } (a Contacts filter). Each filter is { field, op, ...payload }. Fields and their ops: type: is_any_of|is_none_of (values client|lead|staff|applicant|other|spam|system); phone: contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty; email: contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty; company: contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty; address: contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty; service_type: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; home_size: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; bedrooms: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; bathrooms: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; preferred_cleaner: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; communication_preference: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; pets: is_any_of (values yes|no); vip: is_any_of (values yes|no); custom_field: is_any_of|is_none_of|contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty (values with fieldKey naming the field); service_category: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values residential|commercial|both); lead_source: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values thumbtack|google_lsa|yelp|bark|website_form|google_business_profile|referral|booking_software|direct|web_chat|other); list: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values list ids); tag: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values tag ids); notes: contains|not_contains|is_empty|is_not_empty; assignee: is_any_of|is_none_of; missing: is_any_of (values name|phone|email|company); date_added: in_last_days|more_than_days_ago|between; last_contact: in_last_days|more_than_days_ago|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; last_message: in_last_days|more_than_days_ago|between; campaign: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values campaign ids); opted_out: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values texts|emails|promos|email_promos|everything); lead_status: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values new|contacted|in_campaign|in_discussion|quote_sent|closed|lost); lead_outcome: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values open|booked|lost|cold|missed|not_a_lead|client); lead_closed: in_last_days|more_than_days_ago|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; provider: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values any_staff|any_contractor|name:<name>); booking_count: eq|gt|lt|at_least|at_most|between; last_booking: in_last_days|more_than_days_ago|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; next_booking: in_next_days|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; first_booking: more_than_days_ago|in_last_days|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; frequency: is_any_of (values recurring|one_time); schedule: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty (values weekly|every_2_weeks|every_3_weeks|every_4_weeks|every_6_weeks|every_8_weeks|custom_weekly|other); recurring_since: more_than_days_ago|in_last_days|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; last_service: is_any_of|is_none_of|is_empty|is_not_empty; last_booking_price: at_least|at_most|between|is_empty|is_not_empty; lifetime_value: gt|lt|at_least|at_most|between|is_empty|is_not_empty. Payload per op: is_any_of -> values: [...]; is_none_of -> values: [...]; contains -> text; not_contains -> text; in_last_days -> days; more_than_days_ago -> days; in_next_days -> days; between -> from+to (YYYY-MM-DD) for dates, min+max for numbers; eq -> number; gt -> number; lt -> number; at_least -> number; at_most -> number; is_empty -> nothing; is_not_empty -> nothing. Sort is a list of { field, dir: asc|desc } with field one of name|type|phone|email|company|assignee|last_contact|date_added|booking_count|last_booking|next_booking|lifetime_value|provider|service_category|lead_source.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

offer_expiry_days.description: Days the offer stays good after each person's first message; {{Offer Expiry Date}} quotes the date.

offer_text.description: offer_text is the offer, written the way the builder writes it ("$25 off your next booking", "10% off your next booking", "a free fridge clean"); {{Offer}} sends those exact words to every recipient. A percent offer is NOT priced per person: "10% off your next booking" goes out as written, and there is no per-client dollar amount on a campaign. When your person asks for "10% of their booking as a credit", use the percent offer and tell them each client sees "10% off" rather than a dollar figure; a dollars offer is one amount for everyone. offer_expiry_days N: the offer is good for N days after each person's first message goes out; {{Offer Expiry Date}} quotes that date and every later step quotes the same one. When your person says to give clients a credit ("a $29.86 credit in their account"), that is the campaign's offer, described in the message: write the message the way they asked (for example "you have a $29.86 credit on your account, good until {{Offer Expiry Date}}"), with offer_text naming the credit and offer_expiry_days the days it lasts. Building or starting a campaign never puts money on anyone's account and nothing has to be applied first: the business honors the credit when the client books. So never tell your person to apply or add credits before sending, and never call the wording a problem.

sms_opt_out_line.description: Which opt-out line ends the first text: prefer_not = "If you'd prefer not to hear about promos like this, just reply stop."; stop_these = "To stop receiving promos from us, just reply stop."; not_interested = "Not interested? Just reply stop."; reply_stop = "Reply STOP to opt out.". Absent on create = the business's default.

metric.description: What the two are compared on; default responded (replied or booked). clicked and opened are email only.

emailSubject.description: Email steps only: version B's subject (absent = A's subject).

template.description: Version B's words; the step's own template is version A. Same merge tags.

abTest.description: An A/B copy test on this text or email step, inside this ONE campaign (never split the audience into two campaigns): each person gets A or B by a stable half-and-half split for the whole campaign, and no winner is picked automatically. null on edit_campaign stops the test (A stays). Per-version results (sent, delivered, replied, booked, responded, opted_out, and whether the gap is real yet): read campaigns with campaign set to this one (its ab_results); who got which: read campaign_recipients, group_by variant.

channel.description: text (default), email, or call (a call task for the team; template is the call notes).

delayDays.description: Days after the previous step (the opener's is 0).

emailSubject.description: An email step's subject line; merge tags allowed.

fallbackTemplate.description: Only when the template uses {{Address}}: what contacts with no address on file get instead.

sent_by.description: Who sends a text or email step: sergio (the default for a new message; it still leaves only under the business's Sending setting, and a campaign with one is the owner's to start) or team_approves_draft (a person reviews and sends it). Left out on an edit, the step keeps what the step in its place had.

template.description: Message text uses Sergio's merge tags, exactly as spelled: {{Client First Name}} (The recipient's own first name); {{User Company}} (Your business name, exactly as it is set on your organization); {{User First Name}} (The first name of the teammate sending the message (your business profile name when Sergio sends it on its own)); {{Offer}} (This campaign's own offer text, exactly as written on the campaign (e.g. "$29.89 off next booking")); {{Offer Expiry Date}} (The day this client has to book by. The same date every step of their sequence quotes); {{Company Phone Number}} (Your primary business phone number, set once in Settings); {{Business Website}} (Your business website, set once in Settings under Business); {{Review Link}} (Your Google review link, set once in Settings and shared by every message that asks for a review); {{Last Visit Date}} (The date of the client's most recent visit. A contact with no past visit is held for you to write); {{Address}} (The recipient's address on file. For a message about a booking, that booking's address); {{pleasantries}} (A short opener in your voice that fits the day the text actually goes out ("Happy Friday!" on a Friday, "Hope your week is going well!" midweek). Updates on its own if the send time moves. Use it in some messages, not every one); {{Goodwill}} (A closing well-wish in your voice that fits when the text actually goes out ("Have a great weekend!" on a Friday afternoon). Updates on its own if the send time moves). Never hard-code the business name or a client name, and never write a bracketed placeholder like [first name]. {{Offer}} needs offer_text set; {{Offer Expiry Date}} needs offer_expiry_days set. The first text automatically ends with the campaign's opt-out line (sms_opt_out_line), so do not write one.

text_by_email_subject.description: The one email subject every text step takes when it goes by email to someone Sergio may not text. An email step keeps its own.

name: edit_campaign
title: Edit, pause or archive a campaign
